turns.user_utterance: My card's frozen, what can I do?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry to hear that—when you say “frozen,” do you mean the card is blocked due to suspicious activity, or is it because you entered your PIN incorrectly and it’s locked? Also, are you trying to use it in a shop/online, or at an ATM?

turns.user_utterance: I think I entered the wrong PIN a few times and now it won’t work, even in the shop.
turns.assistant_response: Thanks—if the wrong PIN was entered a few times and it won’t work even in shops, your card is likely PIN-blocked. Please try verifying you’re using the correct card PIN for chip-and-PIN transactions; then you’ll need to unblock/reset your PIN using the app (or via support if you can’t access it). Do you have access to your account/app right now to change/unblock your PIN?
